_doc: Seconds each step of .github/workflows/pages.yml may take, keyed 'job/step name'. tools/step_budgets.py check-run fails the run's budgets job on a step over its budget or with no row; tools/test_step_budgets.sh fails on a step with no row, and on a step that reads the whole corpus without naming the cache it restores ('cache'), how it limits itself to what changed ('incremental'), or why it can do neither ('uncached'). Raise a budget only with the reason in the commit: a budget that moves with every slowdown catches nothing.

build/Draw the social cards.note: a code change to the card redraws up to OG_LIMIT cards at about a second each; the list itself is cached

build/Generate the crawlable pages.uncached: it writes one page per puzzle into a fresh checkout, and the pages are the output; already spread across the cores

build/Stage the site.uncached: it links every generated page into _site and checks its links; already spread across the cores

validate/Choose what to check.note: a full check fetches the whole tree here, in four streams; the diff and the scope are a few seconds

validate/Check every annotation.uncached: the nightly and rule-change full check, spread across the runner's cores (validate_annotations.check_all); its budget is the alarm that it needs a bigger runner or a cache

validate/Check the changed annotations.incremental: only the puzzle files changed since the last successfully deployed commit (Choose what to check)
